text:
Sam: quick sync 100061 100062: can AstraCore give us a 4hr bench window next Thu? want to verify throughput-per-watt after their microkernel changes.
Mei: Astra replied yes for Thu AM. we should keep it scoped: 1 baseline, 1 tuned (microkernel v1.4), and 1 knockout with quant changes.
Carlos: propose metrics: avg tokens/s, watts from rack PDU, 95th perc latency, and power-normalized throughput (tokens/s per watt). also collect GPU clock & die temps.
Nora: marketplace wants a single line: "X% perf/W uplift" and a compact plot. I can write a short blurb if we have final numbers.
Sam: kernel tag `astra/microk/1.4` and quant `q4_simd_v2`. runtime image `redwood/infer:bench-2026-04-02`.
Mei: lab checklist: PDU SNMP creds + OIDs, per-GPU telemetry, KVM access, kernel tarball, and disk image. who owns confirming OIDs with Astra ops?
Carlos: tagging ops: @astra_ops_tom 100062: can you confirm which OIDs map to per-GPU and per-rack watts, and whether you can expose them to our monitoring for the slot?
astra_ops_tom: yes, will provide OIDs and a short SNMP config. we can also enable IPMI for temps. note: Astra asks for a 5-business-day review on any public wording.
Nora: copy/legal constraint noted. do we want an NDA addendum? probably yes for publishing numbers.
Sam: yes, legal should do a short addendum. keep public graphs generic ("AstraCore test cluster") if needed.
Carlos: test plan draft: Thu 08:30 smoke + env check, 08:45 baseline (stock kernel, q4_simd_v2), 09:30 deploy microk1.4 + warmup, 09:45 tuned run, 10:45 quant change run, 11:30 extra validation, 11:45 collect & teardown.
Mei: artifacts: `bench/run.sh --model biglm.onnx --seq 1024 --iters 2000 --profile q4_simd_v2`, `microk-1.4.tar.gz`, runtime image. please verify the run command.
Carlos: draft command: ```bash
./run.sh --model biglm.onnx --seq 1024 --iters 2000 --profile q4_simd_v2 --pkv=on --log-format csv > run_baseline.csv
``` will flip `--pkv=off` and apply kernel for other runs.
Mei: add `--power-sample=1s` to ensure wattage sampling granularity. also include `--gpu-clocks=on` if available.
Sam: logging policy: keep raw CSVs private; allow Astra a 7-day review of raw data before public archive. redact exact SKU in public.
Nora: will draft 150-200 word marketplace blurb and a 1-paragraph joint blog outline. timeline: blurb + chart mock by Wed EOD.
Carlos: I'll own the bench scripts and a small analysis Jupyter that generates the perf/W plot. will push to `gitlab.com/redwood/bench/astra-mini` with clear README.
Mei: ops: @astra_ops_tom please DM creds to me. I'll set up SNMP poller + prometheus scrape and a lightweight collector. :thumbsup:
astra_ops_tom: sending creds in DM now. also, we require a short press review window (5 business days) on the blog.
Sam: action items: Carlos (scripts + graphs), Mei (telemetry + creds), Nora (blurb + blog draft), Sam (coordinate legal + release windows). I'll book a 15m preflight Thu 08:00 PT.
devops-bot: benchmark slot reserved: `astra-mini-1799998888` 100062. Logs will go to `s3://redwood-partners/astra/mini/1799998888/`.
Mei: got it, prepping collectors.
Carlos: pushing initial scripts now, will include `parse_power.py` to align CSV timestamps.
Nora: will ensure copy avoids product SKUs. we'll reference the cluster generically per legal.
Sam: thanks all 100062. see you in the preflight. if any blockers ping this thread.
